verses.1:4: Noah. The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, Japheth.
verses.1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Elishah, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.1:6: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, the Kittim and the Rhodians.
verses.1:8: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim, Put and Canaan.
verses.1:9: And the sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Judadan.
verses.1:10: And Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a giant hunter on the earth.
verses.1:17: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur,
verses.1:28: Now the sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.1:29: And these are the generations of the firstborn of Ishmael: Nebaioth and Kedar, Nabdael, Massa,
verses.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, Kedemah; these are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.1:32: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore to him Zimran, Jokshan, Midian, Medan, Sobak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Dedan and Sheba.
verses.1:33: And the sons of Midian: Gapher, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.1:34: And Abraham fathered Isaac. And the sons of Isaac: Jacob and Esau.
verses.1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeul, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zophar, Gatam, Kenaz, and by Timna, Amalek.
verses.1:37: And the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Omoze.
verses.1:38: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Onan.
verses.1:39: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, Heman, Elath, and Namna.
verses.1:40: The sons of Shobal: Solam, Machanam, Ebal, Sob, and Onan. And the sons of Zibeon: Aith and Sonan.
verses.1:41: The sons of Sonan: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Gethram, and Cheran.
verses.1:42: And the sons of Ezer: Balaam, Zukam, and Onan. The sons of Dishon: Uz and Aran.
verses.1:43: And these are their kings: Balak son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.1:44: And Balak died, and in his place reigned Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah.
verses.1:45: And Jobab died, and in his place reigned Husham from the land of the Temanites.
verses.1:46: And Husham died, and in his place reigned Hadad son of Barad, who struck down Midian in the plain of Moab, and the name of his city was Gittaim.
verses.1:47: And Hadad died, and in his place reigned
verses.1:48: And Hadad died, and in his place reigned Samaa from Masekkah; and Samaa died, and in his place reigned Shaul from Rehoboth by the river. And Shaul died.
verses.1:50: And Balaennor son of Achbor died, and in his place reigned Hadad son of Barad, and the name of his city was Peor.
verses.1:51: And the chiefs of Edom were: Chief Teman, Chief Gola, Chief Jetheth,
verses.1:52: Chief Elibamas, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
verses.1:53: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mazar,
verses.1:54: Chief Mediel, Chief Zaphoin; these are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.2:1: These are the names of the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
verses.2:2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, Asher.
verses.2:3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, three; they were born to him by the daughter of Aua the Canaanite woman. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was wicked before the Lord, and He put him to death.
verses.2:4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.2:5: The sons of Perez: Harson and Jemuel.
verses.2:6: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calca, and Dara, five in all.
verses.2:7: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the obstructor of Israel, who acted unfaithfully concerning the devoted thing.
verses.2:8: And the sons of Ethan: Zaria.
verses.2:9: And the sons of Hezron who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, Chabel, and Aram.
verses.2:10: And Arran fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, ruler of the house of Judah.
verses.2:11: And Nahshon fathered Salmon, and Salmon fathered Boaz.
verses.2:12: And Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse,
verses.2:13: and Jesse fathered his firstborn Eliab, Amminadab the second, Shimea the third,
verses.2:14: Nethanel the fourth, Zaddai the fifth,
verses.2:15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.
verses.2:16: And their sister was Zeruiah. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.2:17: And Abigail gave birth to Amasab, and the father of Amasab was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.2:18: And Caleb, the son of Hezron, fathered Azubah, a wife, and Elioth. And these are her sons: Joasar, Jasub, and Orna.
verses.2:19: And Azubah died, and Caleb took Ephrath for himself, and she bore him Hur.
verses.2:20: And Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
verses.2:21: And after these things Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, and he took her, and he was sixty years old; and she bore him Serug.
verses.2:22: And Serug fathered Jair. And he had twenty-three cities in Gilead.
verses.2:23: And Geshur and Arran took the villages of Sair from them, Kenath and its villages, sixty cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.2:24: And after Hezron died, Caleb came to Ephrathah; and the wife of Hezron was Abijah, and she bore him Ascho, the father of Tekoa.
verses.2:25: And the sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram the firstborn, Benaiah, Araiah, Amram, and Asan his brother.
verses.2:26: And Jerahmeel had another wife, and her name was Atarah; she is the mother of Ozom.
verses.2:27: And the sons of Aram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.2:28: And the sons of Ozom were Shammai and Jada, and the sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
verses.2:29: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihaia, and she bore him Achabar and Moel.
verses.2:30: The sons of Nadab: Alsalad and Ephraim; and Salad died having no children.
verses.2:31: And the sons of Ephraim: Isemiel; and the sons of Isemiel: Sheshan; and the sons of Sheshan: Achai.
verses.2:32: And the sons of Iduda: Achisamas, Jether, Jonathan; and Jether died having no children.
verses.2:33: And the sons of Jonathan: Thaleth and Ozam. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.2:34: And Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, and his name was Jochel.
verses.2:35: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jochel his servant as a wife, and she bore him Attai.
verses.2:36: And Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabad,
verses.2:37: and Zabad fathered Aphamel, and Aphamel fathered Obed,
verses.2:38: and Obed fathered Joshua, and Joshua fathered Azariah,
verses.2:39: and Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Emas,
verses.2:40: and Emas fathered Sismai, and Sismai fathered Shallum,
verses.2:41: and Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
verses.2:42: And the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel: Mareshah his firstborn (he was the father of Ziph), and the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
verses.2:43: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.2:44: And Shema fathered Ramee, the father of Jaklan, and Jaklan fathered Shammai.
verses.2:45: And his son was Maon, and Maon was the father of Gedsur.
verses.2:46: And Gaiphael, the concubine of Caleb, gave birth to Haran, Josan, and Gezue. And Haran fathered Gezue.
verses.2:47: And the sons of Joshua: Regem, Jotham, Sogar, Peleg, Ephah, and Sagae.
verses.2:48: And the concubine of Caleb, Maacah, gave birth to Sheber and Tharam.
verses.2:49: And she gave birth to Sagae, the father of Marmena, and Sau, the father of Machbenah and the father of Gaibal. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.2:50: These were the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim;
verses.2:51: Solomon, the father of Betha; Lammon, the father of Bethlehem; Harim, the father of Beth-gaidon.
verses.2:52: And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haio, Hesira, Monaio,
verses.2:53: Emospheos, the cities of Jair: Haithalim, Miphithim, Hesamathim, and Hemasaraim. From these came out the Zorathites and the sons of Esthaam.
verses.2:54: The sons of Solomon: Bethlehem, Metophathi, Ataroth of the house of Joab, and half of Malathi, Hesari,
verses.2:55: the families of writings living in Games: Argathim, Samathim, Socathim. These are the Kenites who came from Mesema, the father of the house of Recha.
verses.3:1: And these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, by Ahinoam the Israelite; the second, Damniel, by Abigail the Carmelite;
verses.3:2: the third, Absalom, the son of Maacah the daughter of Thoamai, king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah, the son of Haggith;
verses.3:3: the fifth, Shephatiah, of Sabital; the sixth, Ithream, by Ala his wife.
verses.3:4: Six were born to him in Hebron. And he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.3:5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Saman, Soban, Nathan, and Solomon, four by Bathsheba the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.3:6: and Baar, and Elisha, and Eliphelet,
verses.3:7: and Nogah, and Naphath, and Janue,
verses.3:8: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphala, nine.
verses.3:9: All were sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.3:10: The sons of Solomon: Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.3:11: Joram his son, Ozia his son, Joash his son,
verses.3:12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.3:13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.3:14: Amnon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.3:15: And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn, Johanan; the second, Jehoiakim; the third, Zedekiah; the fourth, Shallum.
verses.3:16: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.3:17: And the sons of Jeconiah: Assir, Shealtiel his son,
verses.3:18: Malchiram, and Phaldaias, and Shenazzar, and Jekenia, and Hosamoth, and Denethi.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Shealtiel: Zerubbabel; Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,
verses.3:20: and Hashubah, and Osa, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, and Arobasok, five.
verses.3:21: And the sons of Hananiah: Phalleti, and Isaba his son, Raphal his son, Orna his son, Obadiah his son, Shecaniah his son.
verses.3:22: And the son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the son of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Joel, and Marei, and Noadiah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.3:23: And the sons of Noadiah: Elithana, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.3:24: And the sons of Elithenan: Hodolia, and Asib, and Phara, and Jakun, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Manei, seven.
verses.4:1: And the sons of Judah: Perez, Harson, and Carmi, and Hur, Shobal,
verses.4:2: and Rada his son; and Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These are the generations of the Arathite.
verses.4:3: And these were the sons of Etam: Azrael, and Ragma, and Jabas; and the name of their sister was Heselebbon.
verses.4:4: And Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hosan. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethladen.
verses.4:5: And Sara, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Aoda and Thoada.
verses.4:6: And Aoda bore him Ochaia, and Hephal, and Teman, and Aseran. All these were the sons of Aoda.
verses.4:7: And the sons of Loada: Areth, and Saar, and Sennon.
verses.4:8: And Koe fathered Ennon and Sabatha, and the descendants of the brother of Rechab, the son of Jarim.
verses.4:9: And Igabes was more honored than his brothers; and his mother called his name Igabes, saying, "I gave birth as gabes."
verses.4:10: And Igabes called upon the God of Israel, saying, "If You indeed bless me, and increase my borders, and Your hand is with me, and You make knowledge so as not to humble me." And God brought about all that he asked.
verses.4:11: And Caleb, the father of Ascha, fathered Machir; he was the father of Assathon.
verses.4:12: He fathered Bathraia, and Bessee, and Teman, the father of the city of Nahash, the brother of Eselon the Kenizzite. These were the men of Rechab.
verses.4:13: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
verses.4:14: And Manathi fathered Ophrah. And Seraiah fathered Jobab, the father of Ageaddair, for they were craftsmen.
verses.4:15: And the sons of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh: Er, Adai, and Noom. And the sons of Ada: Kenaz.
verses.4:16: And the sons of Aleel: Zib, and Ziphah, and Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.4:17: And the sons of Esri: Jetheri, Porad, and Epher, and Amon. And Jether fathered Maion, and Shemen, and Mareth, the father of Esthemon.
verses.4:18: And his wife—she was Hadeia—bore Jered, the father of Gedor, and Habisa, the father of Soco, and Chetiel, the father of Zamon. And these were the sons of Gelia, the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Noroel took.
verses.4:19: And the sons of the woman Idouia, the sister of Nacheth, were both Dalila, the father of Keilah, and Semegon, the father of Joman; and of Manaem, the father of Keilah: Hatamei and Esthemone the Nochathite.
verses.4:20: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Ana the son of Phana, and Inon. And the sons of Seei: Zoan. And the sons of Zoab,
verses.4:21: the sons of Shelom, the son of Judah: Er, the father of Lecah, and Madath, the father of Maicha; and the generations of the houses of ephrath habak for the house of Esoba;
verses.4:22: and Jokim, and the men of Sochetha, Joada and Saia, who lived in Moab; and he turned them back, habederein athoukiein.
verses.4:23: These were the potters who lived in Azaim and Gabaera with the king; in his kingdom they grew strong and lived there.
verses.4:24: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarin, Zares, Shaul;
verses.4:25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son,
verses.4:27: Shimei had sixteen sons and three daughters; and their brothers did not have many sons; and all their clans did not increase like the sons of Judah.
verses.4:28: And they lived in Beersheba, and Sama, and Moladah, and Hesereulab;
verses.4:30: and Bathun, and Hormah, and Okla,
verses.4:31: and Beth-mareimoth, and Hemisusesoram, and the house of Braumseorim. These were their cities until King David.
verses.4:32: And their villages were Etam, and Rimmon, and Thokka, and Aisar, five cities.
verses.4:33: And all their villages around these cities as far as Baalath; this was their possession and their enrollment.
verses.4:34: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Josiah the son of Amaziah,
verses.4:35: and Joel; and he was the son of Isabia, the son of Saraau, the son of Asiel;
verses.4:36: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jasuia, and Asaiah, the sons of Aosal, the son of Saphal,
verses.4:37: the son of Amon, the son of Idia, the son of Samar, the son of Simeon.
verses.4:38: These were those who divided by the names of leaders in their generations; and in their ancestral houses they multiplied into a multitude.
verses.4:39: And they went until they came to Gerar, as far as the east of Gai, to seek pastures for their livestock.
verses.4:40: And they found rich and good pastures; and the land was wide before them, and there was peace and quiet, for those who lived there previously were from the sons of Ham.
verses.4:41: And these who were written by name came in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and struck their houses and the Minaeans whom they found there, and devoted them to destruction to this day; and they lived in their place, because there were pastures for their livestock there.
verses.4:42: And from them, from the sons of Simeon, five hundred men went to Mount Seir, and Pelatiah, and Noadiah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Jesthen, were their leaders;
verses.4:43: and they struck those who were left behind, the remnant of Amalek, to this day.
verses.5:1: And the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: for he was the firstborn, and when he went up onto his father's bed, he gave his blessing to his son Joseph, the son of Israel, and he was not enrolled in the genealogy for the birthright,
verses.5:2: for Judah was mighty in strength even among his brothers, and a ruler was to come from him, and the blessing belonged to Joseph.
verses.5:3: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.
verses.5:4: The sons of Joel: Shimei, and Benaiah his son. And the sons of Gog, the son of Shimei:
verses.5:5: his son Echa, his son Recha, his son Joel,
verses.5:6: his son Beel, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria exiled; he was chief of the Reubenites.
verses.5:7: And his brothers, by his clan, in their genealogical enrollments according to their descent: the chief, Joel, and Zechariah,
verses.5:8: and Balek the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel; he lived in Aroer and up to Nebo and Beelmasson,
verses.5:9: and toward the east he lived as far as the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because he had much livestock in the land of Gilead.
verses.5:10: And in the days of Saul they made war against the resident aliens, and they fell by their hands, living in tents, even all of them to the east of Gilead.
verses.5:11: The sons of Gad lived opposite them in Bashan as far as Elcha:
verses.5:12: Joel the firstborn, and Sabat the second, and Janin the scribe in Bashan.
verses.5:13: And their brothers, according to their ancestral houses: Michael, Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Chima, and Zia, and Obed, eight.
verses.5:14: These were the sons of Abihaia, the sons of Huri, the son of Idai, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Isai, the son of Juri, the son of Zabucham,
verses.5:15: the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni; chief of an ancestral house,
verses.5:16: of the inhabitants in Gilead, in Bashan and in their villages, and all the surrounding regions of Geriam as far as the exit.
verses.5:17: The genealogical enrollment of all of them was in the days of Jotham king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.5:18: The sons of Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, from the sons of might, men bearing shields and a sword, and drawing the bow, and trained in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty going out to battle formation.
verses.5:19: And they made war with the Hagrites, the Turaeans, the Naphisadaeans, and the Nodabites,
verses.5:20: and they prevailed over them; and the Hagrites and all their encampments were given into their hands, because they cried out to God in the war and He listened to them, because they hoped in Him.
verses.5:21: And they captured their possessions: five thousand camels, and two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, two thousand donkeys, and one hundred thousand souls of men;
verses.5:22: for many wounded fell, because the war was from God. And they lived in their place until the exile.
verses.5:23: And the half-tribe of Manasseh lived from Bashan as far as Baileim and Senir and Mount Hermon; and in Lebanon they multiplied.
verses.5:24: And these were the heads of their ancestral house: Epher, and Sei, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jeliel, men strong in might, men of renown, chiefs of their ancestral houses.
verses.5:25: And they acted unfaithfully against the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had removed from before them.
verses.5:26: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Phaloch king of Assyria and the spirit of Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and he exiled Reuben and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Chaach and Habor and to the river Chozar, to this day.
verses.5:27: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.5:28: And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.5:29: And the children of Amram: Aaron and Moses and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.5:30: Eleazar fathered Phinehas, Phinehas fathered Abishua,
verses.5:31: Abishua fathered Bukki, and Bukki fathered Uzzi,
verses.5:32: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, Zerahiah fathered Mariel,
verses.5:33: and Mariel fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub,
verses.5:34: and Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz,
verses.5:35: and Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, and Azariah fathered Johanan,
verses.5:36: and Johanan fathered Azariah; he served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.5:37: And Azariah fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub,
verses.5:38: and Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Shallum,
verses.5:39: and Shallum fathered Hilkiah, and Hilkiah fathered Azariah,
verses.5:40: and Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.
verses.5:41: And Jehozadak went in the exile with Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.6:1: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.6:2: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
verses.6:3: The sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.6:4: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of Levi according to their families.
verses.6:5: Of Gershon, of Libni his son: Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.6:6: Joab his son, Adi his son, Jaara his son, Jeatherai his son.
verses.6:7: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Haresi his son,
verses.6:8: Elkanah, and Abiathar his son, Aseri his son,
verses.6:9: Kohath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, Shaul his son.
verses.6:10: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Alimoth,
verses.6:11: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Kainath his son,
verses.6:12: Eliab his son, Idaer his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.6:13: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Sani, and Abijah.
verses.6:14: Sons: Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.6:15: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.6:16: And these are those whom David appointed over the hands of the singers in the house of the Lord at the resting of the ark.
verses.6:17: And they were ministering before the tabernacle of the house of testimony with instruments until Solomon built the house in Jerusalem; and they stood according to their ordinance for their ministries.
verses.6:18: And these are those who stood and their sons. From the sons of Kohath: Heman the singer, son of Joel, son of Samuel,
verses.6:19: son of Elkanah, son of Jeroboam, son of Eliel, son of Tohu,
verses.6:20: son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amathiu,
verses.6:21: son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,
verses.6:22: son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Abiasar, son of Korah,
verses.6:23: son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
verses.6:24: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand: Asaph, son of Berechiah, son of Shimea,
verses.6:25: son of Michael, son of Baaseiah, son of Malchijah,
verses.6:26: son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Aziah,
verses.6:27: son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,
verses.6:28: son of Jahath, son of Gershon, son of Levi.
verses.6:29: And the sons of Merari their brother, on the left: Ethan, son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,
verses.6:30: son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah,
verses.6:31: son of Bani, son of Shemer,
verses.6:32: son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
verses.6:33: And their brothers according to the houses of their families, the Levites, were given for all the work of the ministry of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.6:34: And Aaron and his sons were burning incense on the altar of burnt offerings and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the holy of holies, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God commanded.
verses.6:35: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.6:36: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.6:37: Mariel his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.6:38: Zadok his son, Ahisama his son.
verses.6:39: And these are their dwelling places in their villages within their borders, for the sons of Aaron, for their family of the Kohathites, for the lot was theirs.
verses.6:40: And they gave them Hebron in Judea and its pasturelands around it.
verses.6:41: And the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb, son of Jephunneh.
verses.6:42: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah and its pasturelands, and Selna and its pasturelands, and Eshtemoa and its pasturelands,
verses.6:43: and Jeththar and its pasturelands, and Debir and its pasturelands,
verses.6:44: and Ashan and its pasturelands, and Attan and its pasturelands, and Beth-shemesh;
verses.6:45: and from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba and its pasturelands, and Alemeth and its pasturelands, and Anchoch and its pasturelands. All their cities were thirteen cities according to their families.
verses.6:46: And to the remaining sons of Kohath, from the families, from the tribe, from the half-tribe of Manasseh, by lot: ten cities.
verses.6:47: And to the sons of Gershon according to their families, from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan: thirteen cities.
verses.6:48: And to the sons of Merari according to their families, from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Dan, from the tribe of Zebulun, by lot: twelve cities.
verses.6:49: And the sons of Israel gave the Levites the cities and their pasturelands.
verses.6:50: And they gave by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon these cities which he named.
verses.6:51: And of the families of the sons of Kohath, cities of their borders were from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.6:52: And they gave him the cities of refuge: Shechem and its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer and its pasturelands,
verses.6:53: and Ikaam and its pasturelands, and Beth-horon and its pasturelands,
verses.6:54: and Eglam and its pasturelands, and Gethoron and its pasturelands;
verses.6:55: and from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Amar and its pasturelands, according to family, for the remaining sons of Kohath.
verses.6:56: To the sons of Gershon, from the families of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan from Bashan and its outskirts, and Aseroth and its pasturelands;
verses.6:57: and from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its pasturelands, and Deberi and its pasturelands, and Dabor and its pasturelands,
verses.6:58: and Ramoth, and Enan and its pasturelands;
verses.6:59: and from the tribe of Asher: Maasa and its pasturelands, and Abaran and its pasturelands,
verses.6:60: and Hukok and its pasturelands, and Rehob and its pasturelands;
verses.6:61: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its pasturelands, and Hammoth and its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim and its pasturelands.
verses.6:62: To the remaining sons of Merari, from the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmon and its pasturelands, and Thachchia and its pasturelands;
verses.6:63: from beyond the Jordan, and Jericho toward the west of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness and its pasturelands,
verses.6:64: and Kadamos and its pasturelands, and Maephla and its pasturelands;
verses.6:65: and from the tribe of Gad: Rammon-gilead and its pasturelands, and Maanaith and its pasturelands,
verses.6:66: and Heshbon and its pasturelands, and Gezer and its pasturelands.
verses.7:1: And for the sons of Issachar: Tholaek, Phut, Jassur, and Shimron, four.
verses.7:2: And the sons of Thole: Uzzi, Raphara, Riel, Eikan, Basan, and Isamuel, chiefs of the houses of their families belonging to Tholai, mighty in strength according to their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.7:3: And the sons of Zirri: Zaria and Michael; and the sons of Zaria: Mibdia, Rael, and Isshiah, five, all of them chiefs.
verses.7:4: And with them, according to their generations, according to their ancestral houses, those mighty to draw up in battle array for war were thirty-six thousand, because they multiplied wives and sons.
verses.7:5: And their brothers among all the families of Issachar, also mighty in strength, were eighty-seven thousand, the number of all of them.
verses.7:7: And the sons of Badee: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Arimoth, and Uri, five, chiefs of ancestral houses, mighty in strength; and their number was twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
verses.7:8: And the sons of Abachi: Amarias, Joash, Eliezer, Elithainan, Amaria, Auremoth, Abihud, Anathoth, and Gemeeth. All these were sons of Amachir,
verses.7:9: and their number according to their generations, chiefs of the houses of their families, mighty in strength, was twenty thousand two hundred.
verses.7:10: And the sons of Ariel: Balaan. And the sons of Balaan: Jeush, Benjamin, Aoth, Canaan, Zethan, Ramessai, and Achisadar.
verses.7:11: All these were sons of Ariel, chiefs of the families, mighty in strength, seventeen thousand two hundred, going out in force to wage war;
verses.7:12: and Sapphin and Happhin, and the sons of Raom, his son Aher.
verses.7:13: The sons of Naphtali: Jisiel, Guni, Issier, and Solomon, sons of Balam.
verses.7:14: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his Syrian concubine bore; she bore Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.7:15: And Machir took a wife for Hamphin and Mamphin; and the name of his sister was Maacah, and the name of the second was Sapphaad.
verses.7:16: And Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Suros; his son was Ulam,
verses.7:17: Badam. These were sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.7:18: And his sister Malecheth bore Isadek, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.7:19: And the sons of Semira were Jaaim, Shechem, Lakeim, and Alialim.
verses.7:20: And the sons of Ephraim: Sothalath. The sons of Laada: his son Noome,
verses.7:21: his son Zabad, his sons Ozar and Elead; and the men of Gath who were born in the land killed him, because they went down to take their livestock.
verses.7:22: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and their brothers came to comfort him.
verses.7:23: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Bargaa, because, "In misfortunes he came to be in my house
verses.7:24: and among those who remained." And he built Beth-horon, the lower and the upper. And the sons of Ozan: Seera
verses.7:25: and Raphe, his sons; Saraph and Thalees, his sons; Tahan, his son.
verses.7:26: To Ladan his son: sons of Amioueid, sons of Eleimasai,
verses.7:27: sons of Num, sons of Joshua, his sons.
verses.7:28: And their possession and their dwelling place were Bethel and its villages, to the east Naarnan, to the west Gezer and its villages, and Shechem and its villages as far as Gaian and its villages;
verses.7:29: and as far as the borders of the sons of Manasseh: Beth-shean and its villages, Thalme and its villages, and Balad and its villages, Megiddo and its villages, Dor and its villages; in this the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel, lived.
verses.7:30: The sons of Asher: Inina, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriga, and Sore, and their sister.
verses.7:31: The sons of Bericha: Gaber and Mellie; he was the father of Bezaith.
verses.7:32: And Heber fathered Iphamel, Samer, Hothan, and Sola, their sister.
verses.7:33: And the sons of Aphalech: Baisechi, Imabael, and Asith; these were sons of Japhalel.
verses.7:34: And the sons of Shemer: Achiuia, Hobab, Akaran,
verses.7:35: and Balaam; his brothers were Sochath, Imna, Zeme, and Amaa.
verses.7:36: The sons of Sophas: Chuchi, Hanarphar, Sula, Sabri, Imare,
verses.7:37: Basan, Oa, Shamma, Salisa, Jethra, and Beera.
verses.7:38: And the sons of Jether: Iphina, Phasphai, and Ara.
verses.7:39: And the sons of Ola: Orech, Hanniel, and Rasia.
verses.7:40: All these were sons of Asher, all chiefs of families, chosen, mighty in strength, leading chiefs; their number for battle array to wage war, their number was twenty-six thousand men.
verses.8:1: And Benjamin fathered Beleleel his firstborn, and Saba the second, Japhael the third,
verses.8:2: Joa the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.8:3: And Bela had sons: Ali, Gera, Abihud,
verses.8:6: These are the sons of Ehud; these are chiefs of ancestral families for the inhabitants of Gaber, and they deported them to Machanathi;
verses.8:7: and Nooma, Ahijah, and Gera. He was Higaam; he fathered Naana and Jachichol.
verses.8:8: And Saarel fathered children in the plain of Moab after he had sent away Sosin and Ibaada his wife.
verses.8:9: And by his wife Hada he fathered Jobab, Jebia, Mesha, Melchas,
verses.8:10: Idos, Sabia, and Imama. These were chiefs of ancestral families.
verses.8:11: And by Hosimen he fathered Abitub and Alphaad.
verses.8:12: And the sons of Alphaad were Obed, Misham, and Semer; he built Onan and its villages.
verses.8:13: And Beriah and Shema; these were chiefs of the ancestral families for the inhabitants of Elam, and they drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.8:16: Michael, Saphan, and Joachan were the sons of Beriah.
verses.8:18: Samari, Zaria, and Joab were the sons of Elchaad.
verses.8:21: Abijah, Beriah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Samaith.
verses.8:25: Athin, Jepheria, and Pheliel were the sons of Soiek.
verses.8:27: Jasaraia, Seraiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
verses.8:28: These were chiefs of ancestral families, chiefs according to their generations; these lived in Jerusalem.
verses.8:29: And in Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, and his wife's name was Molcha.
verses.8:30: And her firstborn son was Abalon, and Zur, Kish, Baalakaim, Adad,
verses.8:31: Dur, his brother, Zachur, and Mikloth.
verses.8:32: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. And these also lived opposite their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.
verses.8:33: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Amminadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.8:34: And the sons of Jonathan: Merib-baal; and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.8:35: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, Melchel, Tarea, and Zak.
verses.8:36: And Zak fathered Jad and Jada; and Jada fathered Salaimath, Salmo, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Maisa.
verses.8:37: And Maisa fathered Binea; Raphai was his son, Salasath his son, Azel his son.
verses.8:38: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Ezrikai his firstborn, Ishmael, Seraiah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.8:39: And the sons of Asel his brother: Elam his firstborn, Gag the second, Eliphalis the third.
verses.8:40: And the sons of Elim were men strong in might, drawing the bow and multiplying sons and sons of sons, one hundred fifty. All these were from the sons of Benjamin.
verses.9:1: And all Israel, their enrollment—and these are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, with those who were resettled in Babylon because of their lawless deeds.
verses.9:2: And those who formerly lived in their possessions in the cities of Israel were Levite sons, the priests, and those who were given.
verses.9:3: And in Jerusalem there lived some of the sons of Judah, and some of the sons of Benjamin, and of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh.
verses.9:4: And Gothi, and the son of Sammiu, son of Omri, sons of the sons of Perez and of the son of Judah.
verses.9:5: And from the Shilonites, Asaiah his firstborn.
verses.9:6: From the sons of Zerah, Epiel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
verses.9:7: And from the sons of Benjamin: Shallum son of Moollam, son of Hodaviah, son of Haana,
verses.9:8: and Banaam son of Jeroham; and these were the sons of Uzzi son of Machir; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Benaiah;
verses.9:9: and their brothers according to their generations were nine hundred fifty-six; all the men were leaders of families according to their family houses.
verses.9:10: And from the priests: Jedaiah, and Joiarim, and Jachin,
verses.9:11: and Azariah, sons of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Marmoth, son of Ahitub, ruler of the house of God,
verses.9:12: and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah; and Maasaiah son of Adiel, son of Jediu, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,
verses.9:13: and their brothers, leaders of family houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty, mighty in strength for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.9:14: And from the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, from the sons of Merari,
verses.9:15: and Bakar, and Rarael, Gilead, and Mattaniah son of Micah, son of Zichri, son of Asaph,
verses.9:16: and Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Gilead, son of Jothon; and Berechiah son of Ossa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.9:17: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akum, Tammam, and Aimam, and their brothers; Shallum was the leader;
verses.9:18: and until this time they are at the king's gate toward the east; these are the gates of the camps of the sons of Levi.
verses.9:19: And Solomon son of Koreb, son of Abiasaph, son of Korah, and his brothers of his father's house, the Korahites, were over the works of the service, guarding the watches of the tent; and their fathers were over the camp, guarding the entrance.
verses.9:20: And Phinehas son of Eleazar was ruler over them formerly, and these were with him.
verses.9:21: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the tent of testimony.
verses.9:22: All those chosen for the gates, at the gates, were two hundred twelve; these were in their courtyards—their enrollment; David and Samuel the seer established these in their faithfulness.
verses.9:23: And these and their sons were over the gates in the house of the Lord, in the house of the tent, to keep guard.
verses.9:24: Toward the four winds were the gates: toward the east, the sea, the north, and the south.
verses.9:25: And their brothers were in their courtyards, to enter every seven days from time to time with these,
verses.9:26: for four mighty men of the gates are in faithfulness. The Levites were over the chambers, and over the treasuries of the house of God they will encamp,
verses.9:27: for a watch is upon them; and these are over the keys morning by morning to open the doors of the temple.
verses.9:28: And some of them are over the vessels of the service, for they will bring them in by number.
verses.9:29: And some of them were appointed over the vessels and over all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.9:30: And some of the sons of the priests were mixers of the ointment and for the spices.
verses.9:31: And Mattathias from the Levites—he was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite—was in faithfulness over the works of the sacrifice of the griddle of the high priest.
verses.9:32: And Benaiah the Kohathite, from their brothers, was over the loaves of presentation, to prepare them Sabbath by Sabbath.
verses.9:33: And these were the singers, leaders of the families of the Levites, appointed divisions; for day and night were upon them in the works.
verses.9:34: These were the leaders of the families, leaders according to their generations; these lived in Jerusalem.
verses.9:35: And in Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and the name of his wife was Maacah;
verses.9:36: and his firstborn son was Sabadon, and Isir, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.9:37: and Jedur, and a brother, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.9:38: And Mikloth fathered Shamaa. And these lived in the midst of their brothers in Jerusalem, in the midst of their brothers.
verses.9:39: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Amminadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.9:40: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.9:41: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea.
verses.9:42: And Ahaz fathered Jada, and Jada fathered Gameleth, and Gazaoth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza,
verses.9:43: and Moza fathered Baana; Rephaiah was his son, Azel his son.
verses.9:44: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam his firstborn, Ishmael, and Seraiah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.
verses.10:1: And the foreigners fought against Israel, and they fled from before the foreigners and fell wounded on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:2: And the foreigners pursued after Saul and after his sons; and the foreigners struck down Jonathan, and Amminadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.10:3: And the battle grew heavy against Saul; and the archers found them with bows and pains, and they suffered pain from the bows.
verses.10:4: And Saul said to the one who carried his armor, "Draw your sword and pierce me through with it, so that these uncircumcised men may not come and mock me." But the one who carried his armor was not willing, because he was greatly afraid; so Saul took the sword and fell upon it.
verses.10:5: And the one who carried his armor saw that Saul had died, and he also fell upon his sword.
verses.10:6: And Saul and three of his sons died on that day, and all his house died together.
verses.10:7: And every man of Israel who was in the valley saw that Israel had fled, and that Saul and his sons had died, and they abandoned their cities and fled; and the foreigners came and lived in them.
verses.10:8: And it happened on the next day that the foreigners came to plunder the wounded, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:9: And they stripped him, and took his head and his armor, and sent into the land of the foreigners all around to proclaim the good news to their idols and to the people.
verses.10:10: And they placed their armor in the house of their god, and they placed his head in the house of Dagon.
verses.10:11: And all those who lived in Gilead heard everything that the foreigners had done to Saul and to Israel.
verses.10:12: And every mighty man arose from Gilead, and they took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh; and they fasted seven days.
verses.10:13: And Saul died because of his lawless deeds that he committed against God concerning the word of the Lord, because he did not keep it; because Saul consulted the medium to inquire, and Samuel the prophet answered him,
verses.10:14: and he did not seek the Lord; so He put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
verses.11:1: And all Israel came to David in Hebron, saying, "Look, we are your bones and your flesh.
verses.11:2: Both yesterday and the day before, while Saul was king, you were the one leading out and bringing in Israel. And the Lord of Israel said to you, 'You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over Israel.'"
verses.11:3: And all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David as king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Samuel.
verses.11:4: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem, that is, Jebus; and there the Jebusites, who inhabited Jebus,
verses.11:5: said to David, "You will not enter here." And he captured the stronghold of Zion, that is, the City of David.
verses.11:6: And David said, "Anyone who strikes a Jebusite first will become chief and commander." And Joab son of Zeruiah went up against it first, and he became chief.
verses.11:7: And David lived in the stronghold; therefore he called it the City of David.
verses.11:8: And he built the city all around; and he fought and took the city.
verses.11:9: And David went on advancing, and the Lord Almighty was with him.
verses.11:10: And these are the chiefs of the mighty men whom David had, who stood strong with him in his kingdom with all Israel to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.11:11: And this is the number of the mighty men of David: Jesebada son of Hachmoni, first of the thirty; he drew his sword once against three hundred wounded men at one time.
verses.11:12: And after him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Archonite; he was among the three mighty men.
verses.11:13: He was with David in Phasodome, and the foreigners were gathered there for battle; and there was a portion of the field full of barley, and the people fled from before the foreigners.
verses.11:14: And he stood in the middle of the portion and saved it, and struck down the foreigners; and the Lord accomplished a great salvation.
verses.11:15: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, to the cave of Adullam, and a camp of the foreigners was in the Valley of the Giants.
verses.11:16: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the foreigners was then in Bethlehem.
verses.11:17: And David longed and said, "Who will give me water to drink from the cistern of Bethlehem that is at the gate?"
verses.11:18: And the three broke through the camp of the foreigners and drew water from the cistern in Bethlehem, which was at the gate, and took it to David; and David was not willing to drink it, and he poured it out as a drink offering to the Lord
verses.11:19: and said, "May God spare me from doing this thing! Shall I drink the blood of these men at the risk of their lives? For at the risk of their lives they brought it." And he would not drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
verses.11:20: And Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the three; he drew his sword against three hundred wounded men at one time, and he was renowned among the three,
verses.11:21: of the three, honored above the two, and he was chief over them; yet he did not attain to the three.
verses.11:22: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the son of a mighty man, whose deeds were many beyond Kabzeel: he struck down the two ariels of Moab, and he went down and struck down the lion in the cistern on a day of snow,
verses.11:23: and he struck down the Egyptian man, an impressive man five cubits tall; and in the hand of the Egyptian was a spear like a weavers' beam. And Benaiah went down against him with a staff and snatched the spear from the hand of the Egyptian, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.11:24: These things Benaiah son of Joad did, and he had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.11:25: He was honored above the thirty, yet he did not attain to the three; and David appointed him over his family.
verses.11:26: And the mighty men of the armies were: Asahel brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.11:27: Shammoth the Hadite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.11:28: Orai son of Ektes of Tekoa, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.11:29: Sibbecai the Hathite, Ilai the Achonite,
verses.11:30: Neere the Netophathite, Chthaod son of Nooza the Netophathite,
verses.11:31: Airi son of Ribai from the hill of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.11:32: Hurai from Nachali Gaash, Abiel the Garabaithite,
verses.11:33: Azbon the Beermin, Samaba the Homite;
verses.11:34: Bennaias the Somologennounin, Jonathan son of Sola the Harachite,
verses.11:35: Achim son of Achar the Hararite, Elphat son of Sthur,
verses.11:37: Hesere the Charmadaite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
verses.11:38: Joel son of Nathan, Mebaal son of Hagri,
verses.11:39: Sele the Ammonite, Nahor the Berothite, the armor-bearer for the son of Zeruiah,
verses.11:41: Uri the Hittite, Zabet son of Achaia,
verses.11:42: Adina son of Shiza, a chief of Reuben, and thirty with him,
verses.11:43: Hanan son of Maacah, and Jehoshaphat the Baithanite,
verses.11:44: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Samatha and Jeia, sons of Kothan the Ararite,
verses.11:45: Elthiel son of Shimri, and Joazae his brother the Jeasite,
verses.11:46: Liel the Miei, and Jeribai, and Josiah his son, Ellaam, and Ethema the Moabite,
verses.11:47: Daliel, and Jobeth, and Essiel the Minabia.
verses.12:1: And these are those who came to David at Sokla, while he was still confined from the presence of Saul son of Kish; and these were among the mighty men, helping in war,
verses.12:2: and with a bow from the right and from the left, and slingers with stones and bows, among the brothers of Saul from Benjamin:
verses.12:3: the chief, Ahiezer, and Joa the son of Ama the Gibeathite, and Joel and Jophalet, sons of Azmaveth, and Berechiah, and Jehul the Anathothite,
verses.12:4: and Shemaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and over the thirty,
verses.12:5: Jeremiah, and Jezel, and Johanan, and Joazabab the Gederathite,
verses.12:6: Azai, and Arimoth, and Badaiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.12:7: Elkanah, and Jesuni, and Azarel, and Jozara, Kaina, and Sobokam, and the Korahites,
verses.12:8: and Elia and Zebadiah, sons of Raham, and those of Gedor.
verses.12:9: And from the Gadites, strong, mighty men of battle array for war separated themselves to David from the wilderness, carrying shields and spears; and their faces were the face of a lion, and they were nimble as gazelles on the mountains in swiftness:
verses.12:10: Aza the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.12:11: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.12:12: Attai the sixth, Eliab the seventh,
verses.12:13: Joan the eighth, Eliezer the ninth,
verses.12:14: Jeremiah the tenth, Melchabannai the eleventh.
verses.12:15: These from the sons of Gad were chiefs of the army; the least one was for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
verses.12:16: These are those who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing over every bank of it; and they drove out all those inhabiting the valleys, from the east to the west.
verses.12:17: And some from the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the help of David.
verses.12:18: And David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me for peace, may my heart be at one toward you; and if to hand me over to my enemies not in truth of hand, may the God of your fathers see and reprove."
verses.12:19: And a spirit clothed Amasai, chief of the thirty, and he said, "Go, and your people, David son of Jesse; peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, because your God has helped you." And David received them and appointed them chiefs of the forces.
verses.12:20: And some from Manasseh went over to David when the foreigners came against Saul to war; and they did not help them, because it came about in counsel from the commanders of the foreigners, saying, "With the heads of those men he will return to his lord Saul."
verses.12:21: When he went to Soglam, there went over to him from Manasseh Adnah, and Tozabath, and Rodiel, and Michael, and Josabaith, and Elimuth, and Semathi; they are captains of thousands of Manasseh.
verses.12:22: And they fought alongside David against the geddur, because they were all mighty men of strength; and they were leaders in the army, in the force,
verses.12:23: for day by day they were coming to David, into a great force, like a force of God.
verses.12:24: And these are the names of the chiefs of the army who came to David at Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.12:25: The sons of Judah, shield-bearers and spear-bearers: six thousand eight hundred mighty men of battle array.
verses.12:26: Of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of strength for battle array: seven thousand one hundred.
verses.12:27: Of the sons of Levi: four thousand six hundred;
verses.12:28: and Toadas, the leader for Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred;
verses.12:29: and Zadok, a young man mighty in strength, and of his father's house twenty-two chiefs.
verses.12:30: And of the sons of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul: three thousand; and still the greater part of them was keeping watch over the guard of the house of Saul.
verses.12:31: And from the sons of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty in strength, men of renown according to their ancestral houses.
verses.12:32: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who also were named by name to make David king.
verses.12:33: And from the sons of Issachar, knowing understanding for the times, knowing what Israel should do: two hundred; and all their brothers were with them.
verses.12:34: And from Zebulun, going out to battle array of war with all weapons of war: fifty thousand, to help David not empty-handed.
verses.12:35: And from Naphtali: one thousand chiefs, and with them, with shields and spears, thirty-seven thousand.
verses.12:36: And from the Danites, drawing up in battle array for war: twenty-eight thousand eight hundred.
verses.12:37: And from Asher, going out to help in war: forty thousand.
verses.12:38: And from beyond the Jordan, from Reuben and the Gadites and from the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all weapons of war: one hundred twenty thousand.
verses.12:39: All these were fighting men, drawing up in battle array with a peaceful soul, and they came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and the rest of Israel was of one soul to make David king.
verses.12:40: And they were there three days, eating and drinking, because their brothers had made preparation.
verses.12:41: And those bordering on them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing to them on camels and donkeys and mules and on calves food, flour, fig cakes, raisins, wine and oil, calves and sheep in abundance, because there was gladness in Israel.
verses.13:1: And David took counsel with the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, with every leader;
verses.13:2: and David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If it is good to you, and it has been prospered from the Lord our God, let us send to your brothers who remain in all the land of Israel, and with them the priests, the Levites, in the cities of their possession, and they will be gathered to us,
verses.13:3: and let us bring over the ark of our God to us; because they have not sought it since the days of Saul."
verses.13:4: And all the assembly said to do so, because the word was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.13:5: And David assembled all Israel from the borders of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring in the ark of God from the city of Jearim.
verses.13:6: And David brought it up; and all Israel went up to the city of David, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord, who sits upon the cherubim, where His name was called.
verses.13:7: And they put the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Amminadab; and Uzza and his brothers were driving the cart.
verses.13:8: And David and all Israel were playing before God with all might, and with singers and with lyres and with harps, with tambourines and with cymbals and with trumpets.
verses.13:9: And they came as far as the threshing floor; and Uzza stretched out his hand to take hold of the ark, and the calf turned it aside.
verses.13:10: And the Lord became angry against Uzza, and struck him there because he stretched out his hand upon the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.13:11: And David was disheartened because the Lord had broken through with a breakthrough against Uzza, and he called that place Breakthrough of Uzza until this day.
verses.13:12: And David feared God on that day, saying, "How will I bring in the ark of God to myself?"
verses.13:13: And David did not turn the ark to himself into the city of David, but turned it aside into the house of Abeddara the Gittite.
verses.13:14: And the ark of God stayed in the house of Abeddara three months; and God blessed Abeddaram and all that belonged to him.
verses.14:1: And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent messengers to David, and cedar logs and builders and woodworkers, to build a house for him.
verses.14:2: And David knew that the Lord had prepared him over Israel, because his kingdom was increased to a height on account of His people Israel.
verses.14:3: And David took more wives in Jerusalem; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.14:4: And these are the names of those born who were his in Jerusalem: Shammua, Isoboam, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.14:5: and Baar, and Ektae, and Eliphelet,
verses.14:6: and Nageth, and Naphath, and Januu,
verses.14:7: and Elishama, and Balegdae, and Emphalet.
verses.14:8: And the foreigners heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, and all the foreigners went up to seek David; and David heard, and went out to meet them.
verses.14:9: And the foreigners came and rushed together in the Valley of the Giants.
verses.14:10: And David inquired through God, saying, "Should I go up against the foreigners, and will You give them into my hands?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up, and I will give them into your hands."
verses.14:11: And he went up to Phaalphathisim, and David struck them there; and David said, "He has broken through my enemies by my hand like a breakthrough of water." Because of this, he called the name of that place Breakthrough of Pharisin.
verses.14:12: And they abandoned their gods, and David said to burn them in fire.
verses.14:13: And once more the foreigners rushed together again in the Valley of the Giants.
verses.14:14: And David inquired again of God, and God said to him, "You shall not go after them; turn away from them, and you will come to them near the pear trees.
verses.14:15: And it will be, when you hear the sound of the shaking of the very tops of the pear trees, then you will go out to the battle, because God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the foreigners."
verses.14:16: And he did just as God commanded him, and he struck the camp of the foreigners from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
verses.14:17: And the name of David came to be in all the earth, and the Lord put the fear of him upon all the nations.
verses.15:1: And he made houses for himself in the city of David, and he prepared the place for the ark of God and made a tent for it.
verses.15:2: Then David said, "No one may carry the ark of God except the Levites, for the Lord chose them also to minister to Him forever."
verses.15:3: And David assembled all Israel to Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place that he had prepared for it.
verses.15:4: And David gathered the sons of Aaron, the Levites.
verses.15:5: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief and his brothers, one hundred ten;
verses.15:6: of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief and his brothers, two hundred fifty;
verses.15:7: of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief and his brothers, one hundred fifty;
verses.15:8: of the sons of Elisaphat: Shemaiah the chief and his brothers, two hundred;
verses.15:9: of the sons of Hebron: Ener the chief and their brothers, eighty;
verses.15:10: of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief and his brothers, one hundred twelve.
verses.15:11: And David called Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites: Ariel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Enel, and Amminadab.
verses.15:12: And he said to them, "You are the chiefs of the fathers' houses of the Levites; purify yourselves, you and your brothers, and you will bring up the ark of the God of Israel to where I prepared for it.
verses.15:13: Because you were not there at the first, our God broke out among us, because we did not seek according to the ordinance."
verses.15:14: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves to bring up the ark of the God of Israel.
verses.15:15: And the sons of the Levites took up the ark of God, as Moses had commanded by the word of God according to the writing, with poles upon themselves.
verses.15:16: And David said to the chiefs of the Levites, "Appoint their brothers, the singers, with instruments, harps, lyres, and cymbals, to raise the sound on high with a voice of gladness."
verses.15:17: And the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; and from the sons of Merari, his brothers, Ethan son of Kushaiah.
verses.15:18: And with them were their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Uzziel, Shemiramoth, Jeiel, Elioel, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphena, Makelleiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Uzziah, the gatekeepers.
verses.15:19: And the singers: Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, with bronze cymbals to make the sound heard;
verses.15:20: Zechariah, Uzziel, Shemiramoth, Eithel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with harps according to alamoth;
verses.15:21: and Mattithiah, Enphanaias, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Uzziah, with lyres of amasenith to be strong.
verses.15:22: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was chief of the songs, because he was discerning.
verses.15:23: And Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers of the ark.
verses.15:24: And Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were blowing the trumpets before the ark of God. And Obed-edom and Jehiah were gatekeepers of the ark of God.
verses.15:25: And David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands were going to bring up the ark of the covenant from the house of Obed-edom with gladness.
verses.15:26: And it came about, when God strengthened the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they sacrificed seven calves each and seven rams each.
verses.15:27: And David was wrapped in a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the singers, Jeconiah the chief of the songs of those singing; and upon David was a robe of fine linen.
verses.15:28: And all Israel were bringing up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the shofar, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud on harps and with lyres.
verses.15:29: And it came about that the ark of the covenant of the Lord came as far as the city of David; and Michal daughter of Saul looked out through the window, and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her soul.
verses.16:1: And they brought in the ark of God and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it, and they offered burnt offerings and offerings of deliverance before God.
verses.16:2: And David finished offering burnt offerings and offerings of deliverance, and he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.16:3: And he distributed to every man of Israel, from man even to woman, to each person one baker's loaf of bread and a sweet cake.
verses.16:4: And he appointed before the ark of the covenant of the Lord some of the Levites to minister, sounding aloud, and to give thanks and to praise the Lord, the God of Israel:
verses.16:5: Asaph the leader, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel with instruments, harps, and lyres, and Asaph sounding aloud with cymbals,
verses.16:6: and Benaiah and Uzziel the priests with the trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God
verses.16:7: on that day. Then David first appointed the praising of the Lord by the hand of Asaph and his brothers. A song.
verses.16:8: Give thanks, call upon Him in His name, make known His deeds among the peoples.
verses.16:9: Sing to Him and sing hymns to Him; recount to all His marvels that the Lord has done.
verses.16:10: Praise in His holy name; the heart seeking His good pleasure will be glad.
verses.16:11: Seek and be strong; seek His face continually.
verses.16:12: Remember His marvels that He has done, wonders and judgments of His mouth,
verses.16:13: seed of Israel, His servants, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.16:14: The Lord is our God; in all the earth are His judgments.
verses.16:15: We remember His covenant forever, His word that He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.16:16: which He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac.
verses.16:17: He established it for Jacob as a statute, for Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.16:18: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the measured portion of your inheritance."
verses.16:19: When they were very few in number, diminished as they were, they lived as strangers in it.
verses.16:20: And they went from nation to nation, and from a kingdom to another people.
verses.16:21: He did not permit any man to oppress them, and He rebuked kings concerning them:
verses.16:22: "Do not touch My anointed ones; against My prophets do no harm."
verses.16:23: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; proclaim from day to day His salvation.
verses.16:25: For the Lord is great and exceedingly praiseworthy; He is to be feared above all the gods.
verses.16:26: For all the gods of the nations are idols, and our God made heaven.
verses.16:27: Glory and praise are before Him; strength and exultation are in His place.
verses.16:28: Give to the Lord, Father of the nations, give to the Lord glory and strength;
verses.16:29: take gifts and bring them before Him, and worship the Lord in His holy courts.
verses.16:30: Let all the earth fear before His presence; let the earth be established and let it not be shaken.
verses.16:31: Let heaven be glad and let the earth rejoice, and let them say among the nations, "The Lord is reigning!"
verses.16:32: The sea will roar together with its fullness; the tree of the field and all that is in it.
verses.16:33: Then the trees of the forest will be glad before the presence of the Lord, for He has come to judge the earth.
verses.16:34: Give thanks to the Lord, for it is good, for His mercy is forever.
verses.16:35: And say, "The God of our salvation has saved us! And deliver us from the nations, to praise Your holy name and to exult in Your praises."
verses.16:36: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from eternity. And all the people will say, "Amen." And they praised the Lord.
verses.16:37: And they left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, each day's duty day by day;
verses.16:38: and Obed-edom and his brothers, sixty-eight; and Obed-edom son of Jeduthun and Hosah as gatekeepers;
verses.16:39: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tent of the Lord at Bama, which is in Gibeon,
verses.16:40: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offerings continually, in the morning and in the evening, and according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, all that He commanded for the sons of Israel by the hand of Moses, the servant of God.
verses.16:41: And with him were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen by name to praise the Lord, "For His mercy is forever."
verses.16:42: And with them were trumpets and cymbals for sounding aloud, and instruments of the songs of God; the sons of Jeduthun were at the gate.
verses.16:43: And all the people went, each to his house, and David returned to bless his household.
verses.17:1: And it came about, when David settled in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "Look, I dwell in a cedar house, and the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under curtains."
verses.17:2: And Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your soul, for God is with you."
verses.17:3: And it came about in that night that the word of the Lord came to Nathan:
verses.17:4: "Go and say to David My servant, 'Thus the Lord has said: You will not build a house for Me to dwell in.
verses.17:5: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought Israel up until this day,
verses.17:6: and I was in a tent and in a covering wherever I walked among all Israel. Did I ever speak to one tribe of Israel to shepherd My people, saying, "Why have you not built for Me a cedar house?"'
verses.17:7: And now thus you will say to My servant David, 'Thus says the Lord Almighty: I took you from the sheepfold, from behind the flocks, to be ruler over My people Israel,
verses.17:8: and I was with you wherever you went, and I utterly destroyed all your enemies from before you, and I made for you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.
verses.17:9: And I will set a place for My people Israel and plant them, and they will dwell on their own and will be anxious no longer, and injustice will not again humble them as at the beginning,
verses.17:10: and from the days when I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I humbled all your enemies, and I will increase you, and the Lord will build you.
verses.17:11: And it will come about, when your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, that I will raise up your seed after you, who will be from your body, and I will prepare his kingdom.
verses.17:12: He will build a house for Me, and I will set his throne upright forever.
verses.17:13: I will be a father to him, and he will be a son to Me; and I will not withdraw My mercy from him, as I withdrew it from those who were before you.
verses.17:14: And I will confirm him in My house and in his kingdom forever, and his throne will be set upright forever.'"
verses.17:15: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.17:16: And King David came and sat before the Lord, and said, "Who am I, Lord God, and what is my house, that You have loved me forever?
verses.17:17: And these things were small before You, God, and You have spoken concerning the house of Your servant from afar, and You have looked upon me as a vision of a man, and You have exalted me, Lord God.
verses.17:18: What more will David add to You to give glory? And You know Your servant,
verses.17:19: and according to Your heart You have done all the greatness.
verses.17:20: Lord, there is no one like You, and there is none besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.17:21: And there is no other nation on the earth like Your people Israel, as God led them to redeem for Himself a people, to set for Himself a great and renowned name, to cast out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed out of Egypt.
verses.17:22: And You gave Your people Israel to Yourself as a people forever, and You, the Lord, are God to them.
verses.17:23: And now, Lord, let Your word that You have spoken to Your servant and concerning his house be confirmed forever,
verses.17:24: as they say, 'Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel.' And the house of David Your servant is set upright before You.
verses.17:25: For You have opened the ear of Your servant to build a house for him; therefore Your servant has found occasion to pray before You.
verses.17:26: And now, Lord, You Yourself are God, and You have spoken these good things concerning Your servant.
verses.17:27: And now You have begun to bless the house of Your servant, that it may be forever before You; for You have blessed it, and bless it forever."
verses.18:1: And it came about after these things that David struck down the foreigners and routed them, and he took Gath and its villages from the hand of the foreigners.
verses.18:2: And he struck down Moab, and Moab became servants to David, bringing gifts.
verses.18:3: And David struck down Hadarezer king of Zobah of Hamath, as he was going to set his hand upon the Euphrates River.
verses.18:4: And David captured from them one thousand chariots and seven thousand horses and twenty thousand men; and David disabled all the chariots, and reserved from them one hundred chariots.
verses.18:5: And the Syrians came from Damascus to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, and he struck down among the Syrians twenty-two thousand men.
verses.18:6: And David placed a garrison in Syria near Damascus, and they became servants to David, bringing gifts; and the Lord saved David wherever he went.
verses.18:7: And David took the golden collars that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.18:8: And from Metabechas and from the chosen wars of Hadarezer, David took very much bronze; from it Solomon made the bronze sea and the pillars and the bronze vessels.
verses.18:9: And Thoa king of Hamath heard that David had struck down the entire force of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
verses.18:10: and he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask him concerning peace and to bless him because he had fought against Hadarezer and struck him down (for Thoa was a man at war with Hadarezer), and all kinds of silver and gold vessels.
verses.18:11: And these David consecrated to the Lord along with the silver and the gold that he had taken from all the nations: from Idumea and Moab, and from the sons of Ammon, and from the foreigners, and from Amalek.
verses.18:12: And Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down Idumea in the Valley of Salt, eighteen thousand,
verses.18:13: and he placed garrisons in the valley; and all the Idumeans became servants of David. And the Lord saved him wherever he went.
verses.18:14: And David reigned over all Israel, and he was doing justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.18:15: And Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahijah was recorder,
verses.18:16: and Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Joshua was scribe,
verses.18:17: and Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the priests and Phalteia; and the sons of David were the first successors of the king.
verses.19:1: And it came about after these things that the king of the sons of Ammon died, and Hanan his son reigned in his place.
verses.19:2: And David said, "I will show mercy to Hanan son of Hanas, as his father showed mercy to me." And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David came to the land of the sons of Ammon to comfort him.
verses.19:3: And the leaders of Ammon said to Hanan, "Is it to honor your father in your sight that he sent comforters to you? Have his servants not come to you so that they might search out the city to spy out the land?"
verses.19:4: And Hanan took the servants of David and shaved them, and cut off half of their cloaks up to the fold, and sent them away.
verses.19:5: And they came to report to David about the men, and he sent to meet them, for they were greatly dishonored. And the king said, "Stay in Jericho until your beards grow out, and return."
verses.19:6: And the sons of Ammon saw that the people of David had been put to shame; and Hanan and the sons of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Syria of Mesopotamia and from Syria of Maacah and from Sobal.
verses.19:7: And they hired for themselves chariots and horsemen, thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people, and they came and encamped opposite Medeba; and the sons of Ammon were gathered from their cities and came to fight.
verses.19:8: And David heard, and he sent Joab and the entire army of the mighty men.
verses.19:9: And the sons of Ammon came out and drew up for battle beside the gate of the city; and the kings who had come encamped by themselves in the plain.
verses.19:10: And Joab saw that they stood facing him to fight against him in front and behind; and he chose from every young man of Israel, and they drew up against the Syrians.
verses.19:11: And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they drew up opposite the sons of Ammon.
verses.19:12: And he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you will be a deliverance to me; and if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will save you.
verses.19:13: And the Lord will do what is good."
verses.19:14: And Joab and the people who were with him drew up opposite the Syrians for battle, and they fled from him.
verses.19:15: And the sons of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, and they also fled from before Joab and from before his brother, and went into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.19:16: And the Syrians saw that Israel had routed them, and they sent messengers and brought out the Syrians from beyond the river; and Sophar, commander of the force of Hadarezer, was before them.
verses.19:17: And it was reported to David, and he gathered all Israel, and crossed the Jordan and came upon them and drew up against them. And the Syrians drew up opposite David and fought against him.
verses.19:18: And the Syrians fled from before David, and David killed from the Syrians seven thousand chariots and forty thousand foot soldiers, and he killed Saphath, commander of the force.
verses.19:19: And the servants of Hadarezer saw that they had been defeated before Israel, and they made terms with David and served him; and the Syrians were no longer willing to help Ammon.
verses.20:1: And it happened in the following year, at the going out of the kings, that Joab led the entire force of the army, and they devastated the country of the sons of Ammon; and he came and besieged Rabbah. Now David was staying in Jerusalem; and he struck Rabbah and demolished it.
verses.20:2: And David took the crown of Molchol their king from his head, and its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and in it was a precious stone, and it was upon David's head; and he brought out very great spoils of the city.
verses.20:3: And he brought out the people who were in it and sawed them apart with saws and with iron adzes, and thus David did to the servants, the sons of Ammon; and David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.20:4: And it happened after these things that there was war again in Gezer with the foreigners; then Sibbecai Thosathi struck Saphut, of the sons of the giants, and humbled him.
verses.20:5: And there was war again with the foreigners, and Ellan son of Jair struck Elemee, the brother of Goliath the Gittite, and the shaft of his spear was like a weavers' beam.
verses.20:6: And there was war again in Gath, and there was a man of immense stature, and his fingers and toes were six and six, twenty-four; and he too was a descendant of giants.
verses.20:7: And he taunted Israel, and Jonathan son of Shimea, son of David's brother, struck him.
verses.20:8: This one was born to Rapha in Gath; all of them were four giants, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.21:1: And the devil stood up in Israel, and incited David to number Israel.
verses.21:2: And King David said to Joab and to the leaders of the force, "Go now, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan, and bring it to me, and I will know their number."
verses.21:3: And Joab said, "May the Lord add to His people a hundred times as many as they are, while the eyes of my lord the king look on. All of them are servants to my lord. Why does my lord seek this? Let it not become a sin to Israel."
verses.21:5: And Joab gave the number of the mustering of the people to David; and all Israel was one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword.
verses.21:6: And he did not number Levi and Benjamin among them, because the word of the king prevailed over Joab.
verses.21:7: And it was evil before God concerning this matter, and He struck Israel.
verses.21:8: And David said to God, "I have sinned greatly because I did this thing; and now please take away the wickedness of Your servant, for I have been exceedingly foolish."
verses.21:9: And the Lord spoke to Gad the seer:
verses.21:10: "Go and speak to David, saying, 'Thus says the Lord: Three things I lift up over you; choose for yourself one of them, and I will do it to you.'"
verses.21:11: And Gad came to David and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: 'Choose for yourself
verses.21:12: either three years of famine, or three months for you to flee from before your enemies, and a sword from your enemies to destroy, or for three days the sword of the Lord and death in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying in all the inheritance of Israel.' And now see what I should answer to Him who sent word."
verses.21:13: And David said to Gad, "Even all three are exceedingly distressing to me; I will fall now into the hands of the Lord, for His mercies are exceedingly many, and into the hands of men I will by no means fall."
